```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", echo = FALSE, message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

This report measures three changes that remove work the query does not need:

- **VCF parsing.** `read_bcf` sets htslib's `max_unpack` from the projected columns, so a
  text VCF record is parsed only as far as the selected columns need. A site-only query
  parses no genotypes.
- **CRAM fields.** `read_bam`, `bam_bin_counts`, `duckhts_bam_bed_coverage` and
  `read_pileup` ask the CRAM decoder only for the fields they read
  (`CRAM_OPT_REQUIRED_FIELDS`). `read_bam` now also leaves out read names, MAPQ and
  mate fields unless they are selected.
- **mosdepth medians.** With `use_median := TRUE`, each window clears and scans only
  the depth counters it used instead of all 65,536.

## Inputs

All inputs resolve through the `duckhtsbench` registry; rendering does not download.

| Input | Registry id | Shape |
|---|---|---|
| VCF | `ancestry_1000g_chr22` | 1000 Genomes phase 3 chr22, 1,103,547 records, 2,504 samples, bgzipped text VCF with a tabix index |
| CRAM | `insert_size_hg00403_chr20_cram_2x` with `liftover_grch38_fasta` | 30x HG00403 chr20 repeated twice, 33.6 M reads, CRAM 3 against GRCh38 |
| BAM | `insert_size_hg00403_chr20_bam` | 30x HG00403 chr20, one populated reference |

## Method

- Engines: **baseline**, the extension built from `main` before these changes
  (`PROJECTION_DECODE_BASELINE_EXTENSION`), and **candidate**, the current build
  (`DUCKHTS_EXTENSION`, default `build/release/duckhts.duckdb_extension`).
- Every timed query runs in a fresh DuckDB CLI process (`DUCKDB`, default `duckdb`)
  with `SET threads` and a 16 GiB memory limit. Seconds are the CLI `.timer` wall time of
  the measured statement; peak RSS and CPU seconds (user plus system) are GNU `time`
  for the whole process. Three processes per engine, workload and thread count.
- Each query consumes its output through an exact fingerprint (count plus summed
  hashes), so DuckDB cannot prune the work under test.
- **Correctness before timing:** for every workload, the baseline's and the candidate's
  fingerprints at one thread must be identical; for mosdepth, the MD5 of every output
  file must be identical. A timed run whose result differs from that fingerprint fails
  its cell. Limits set before measuring: 900 s per process and 20 GiB peak RSS.

```{r driver}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(duckhtsbench))

duckdb_bin <- Sys.getenv("DUCKDB", "duckdb")
candidate <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("DUCKHTS_EXTENSION", "build/release/duckhts.duckdb_extension"))
baseline <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv(
  "PROJECTION_DECODE_BASELINE_EXTENSION",
  duckhts_bench_cache_path("benchmarks/projection-decode/baseline/duckhts.duckdb_extension")))
engines <- c(baseline = baseline, candidate = candidate)
wall_limit_s <- 900
rss_ceiling_bytes <- 20 * 1024^3

vcf <- duckhts_bench_artifact_path("ancestry_1000g_chr22")
cram <- duckhts_bench_artifact_path("insert_size_hg00403_chr20_cram_2x")
reference <- duckhts_bench_artifact_path("liftover_grch38_fasta")
bam <- duckhts_bench_artifact_path("insert_size_hg00403_chr20_bam")

sql_string <- function(x) paste0("'", gsub("'", "''", x, fixed = TRUE), "'")
v <- sql_string(vcf)
cr <- sprintf("%s, reference := %s", sql_string(cram), sql_string(reference))

workloads <- data.frame(
  workload = c("vcf_site", "vcf_info", "vcf_tidy_region",
               "cram_count", "cram_pos", "cram_qname", "cram_bin_counts",
               "mosdepth_median"),
  change = c(rep("VCF parsing", 3), rep("CRAM fields", 4), "mosdepth medians"),
  sql = c(
    sprintf("SELECT count(*), sum(POS), sum(hash(POS)) FROM read_bcf(%s);", v),
    sprintf("SELECT count(*), count(INFO_AF), sum(hash(INFO_AF)) FROM read_bcf(%s);", v),
    sprintf(paste("SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT POS), sum(hash(POS, SAMPLE_ID, FORMAT_GT))",
                  "FROM read_bcf(%s, region := '22:20000000-20500000', tidy_format := true);"), v),
    sprintf("SELECT count(*) FROM read_bam(%s);", cr),
    sprintf("SELECT count(*), sum(POS), sum(hash(POS)) FROM read_bam(%s);", cr),
    sprintf("SELECT count(*), sum(hash(QNAME)) FROM read_bam(%s);", cr),
    sprintf("SELECT count(*), sum(count_total), sum(hash(chrom, start, count_total)) FROM bam_bin_counts(%s, 100000, reference := %s);",
            sql_string(cram), sql_string(reference)),
    NA_character_),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# mosdepth writes files: each process gets its own prefix, and the result is the
# MD5 of every output file, so identical bytes are the correctness check.
mosdepth_sql <- function(prefix) {
  sprintf(paste("SELECT success FROM duckhts_mosdepth(%s, %s, by := '500', use_median := TRUE,",
                "no_per_base := TRUE, threads := 1, overwrite := TRUE);"),
          sql_string(prefix), sql_string(bam))
}
mosdepth_files <- function(prefix) {
  files <- Sys.glob(paste0(prefix, ".*"))
  paste(basename(sub(prefix, "PREFIX", files, fixed = TRUE)), unname(tools::md5sum(files)),
        sep = "=", collapse = ";")
}

# One fresh CLI process: the measured statement's wall seconds, whole-process peak
# RSS and CPU seconds, and the last result row.
run_process <- function(extension, threads, sql) {
  script <- tempfile(fileext = ".sql")
  timing <- tempfile(fileext = ".time")
  on.exit(unlink(c(script, timing)), add = TRUE)
  writeLines(c(
    "SET allow_extensions_metadata_mismatch = true;",
    sprintf("LOAD %s;", sql_string(extension)),
    sprintf("SET threads = %d;", threads),
    "SET memory_limit = '16GiB';",
    ".timer on",
    sql), script)
  out <- suppressWarnings(system2(
    "timeout", c(wall_limit_s, "/usr/bin/time", "-f", shQuote("%M %U %S"), "-o", timing,
                 duckdb_bin, "-unsigned", "-csv", "-noheader", "-bail"),
    stdin = script, stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE))
  status <- attr(out, "status")
  times <- as.numeric(sub("^Run Time \\(s\\): real ([0-9.]+).*$", "\\1",
                          grep("^Run Time", out, value = TRUE)))
  results <- grep("^Run Time|^$|^\\[", out, value = TRUE, invert = TRUE)
  timing_lines <- if (file.exists(timing)) readLines(timing, warn = FALSE) else character()
  usage <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(strsplit(utils::tail(c("", timing_lines), 1L), " ")[[1L]]))
  list(
    ok = (is.null(status) || status == 0L) && length(times) > 0L,
    seconds = if (length(times)) times[[1L]] else NA_real_,
    rss_bytes = if (length(usage) == 3L && all(is.finite(usage))) usage[[1L]] * 1024 else NA_real_,
    cpu_seconds = if (length(usage) == 3L && all(is.finite(usage))) usage[[2L]] + usage[[3L]] else NA_real_,
    result = if (length(results)) utils::tail(results, 1L) else NA_character_)
}

run_workload <- function(engine, threads, workload) {
  if (workload != "mosdepth_median") {
    return(run_process(engines[[engine]], threads, workloads$sql[workloads$workload == workload]))
  }
  dir <- tempfile("mosdepth_")
  dir.create(dir)
  on.exit(unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  prefix <- file.path(dir, "out")
  got <- run_process(engines[[engine]], threads, mosdepth_sql(prefix))
  got$result <- if (got$ok) mosdepth_files(prefix) else NA_character_
  got
}
```

```{r measure, eval=params$measure}
stopifnot(file.exists(c(vcf, cram, reference, bam)), all(file.exists(engines)))
dir.create("benchmarks/data", showWarnings = FALSE)

checks <- do.call(rbind, lapply(workloads$workload, function(w) {
  before <- run_workload("baseline", 1L, w)
  after <- run_workload("candidate", 1L, w)
  data.frame(workload = w, baseline = before$result, candidate = after$result,
             equal = before$ok && after$ok && identical(before$result, after$result))
}))
utils::write.csv(checks, "benchmarks/data/projection_decode_checks.csv", row.names = FALSE)
if (!all(checks$equal)) stop("baseline and candidate results differ; not timing")

rows <- list()
for (w in workloads$workload) for (threads in params$threads) for (rep in seq_len(params$reps)) {
  for (engine in names(engines)) {
    got <- run_workload(engine, threads, w)
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      workload = w, engine = engine, threads = threads, rep = rep,
      ok = got$ok && identical(got$result, checks$baseline[checks$workload == w]) &&
        is.finite(got$rss_bytes) && got$rss_bytes <= rss_ceiling_bytes,
      seconds = got$seconds, rss_bytes = got$rss_bytes, cpu_seconds = got$cpu_seconds,
      result = got$result)
  }
}
raw <- do.call(rbind, rows)
utils::write.csv(raw, "benchmarks/data/projection_decode.csv", row.names = FALSE)

meta <- data.frame(
  key = c("source_revision", "candidate_sha256", "baseline_sha256", "baseline_source_revision",
          "duckdb", "nproc", "cpu", "rendered_utc"),
  value = c(
    system2("git", c("rev-parse", "HEAD"), stdout = TRUE),
    sub(" .*", "", system2("sha256sum", candidate, stdout = TRUE)),
    sub(" .*", "", system2("sha256sum", baseline, stdout = TRUE)),
    paste(readLines(file.path(dirname(baseline), "source-revision.txt"), warn = FALSE), collapse = ""),
    system2(duckdb_bin, "--version", stdout = TRUE),
    system2("nproc", stdout = TRUE),
    sub("^model name\\s*:\\s*", "", grep("^model name", readLines("/proc/cpuinfo"), value = TRUE)[[1L]]),
    format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE)))
utils::write.csv(meta, "benchmarks/data/projection_decode_metadata.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Correctness

```{r checks}
checks <- utils::read.csv("benchmarks/data/projection_decode_checks.csv")
knitr::kable(checks[, c("workload", "equal")], format = "pipe")
```

## Results

Median of three fresh processes, with the range; seconds are the measured statement
only, and peak RSS is the largest of the three. A cell with any failed, timed-out,
over-ceiling or mismatching process is marked failed and has no median or speedup.

```{r results, results='asis'}
raw <- utils::read.csv("benchmarks/data/projection_decode.csv")
meta <- utils::read.csv("benchmarks/data/projection_decode_metadata.csv")
keys <- c("workload", "engine", "threads")
cells <- split(raw, raw[keys], drop = TRUE)
cell <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cells, function(rows) {
  passed <- nrow(rows) == params$reps && all(rows$ok)
  data.frame(
    rows[1L, keys],
    status = if (passed) "PASS" else sprintf("FAIL (%d/%d ok)", sum(rows$ok), params$reps),
    seconds = if (passed) round(stats::median(rows$seconds), 2) else NA_real_,
    range = if (passed) sprintf("%.2f-%.2f", min(rows$seconds), max(rows$seconds)) else NA_character_,
    peak_rss_mib = if (passed) round(max(rows$rss_bytes) / 2^20) else NA_real_,
    cpu_seconds = if (passed) round(stats::median(rows$cpu_seconds), 1) else NA_real_,
    row.names = NULL)
}))
wide <- reshape(cell, idvar = c("workload", "threads"), timevar = "engine", direction = "wide")
both_pass <- !is.na(wide$seconds.baseline) & !is.na(wide$seconds.candidate)
wide$speedup <- ifelse(both_pass, round(wide$seconds.baseline / wide$seconds.candidate, 2), NA_real_)
wide <- wide[order(match(wide$workload, workloads$workload), wide$threads), ]
print(knitr::kable(wide, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE))
failed <- raw[!raw$ok, ]
if (nrow(failed)) print(knitr::kable(failed, format = "pipe", caption = "Failed processes"))
print(knitr::kable(meta, format = "pipe"))
```

`read_bam` and `bam_bin_counts` read one populated reference here, so their CRAM cells
run one reader at both thread counts. `duckhts_mosdepth` runs with `threads := 1`
(htslib decompression threads); its processing does not follow `SET threads`.
